description: Compare estimated fees and the net amount a trading-card seller keeps when selling the SAME card across eBay (estimated), Pulltrader selling methods (marketplace, Fulfilled by Pulltrader, branded storefront, and in-person POS), and other marketplaces (TCGplayer, Mana Pool, Misprint, Fanatics Collect, Goldin — estimated fixed-price/Buy Now seller fees). Use this when a seller asks what they would keep/net/take-home on a sale, how fees compare between platforms, or which method leaves them with more money. Calculations are deterministic and use dated fee schedules. Competitor marketplaces are off by default; include them via the `methods` field. Only fixed-price seller fees are modeled — auction formats (hammer price, buyer's premium, negotiated consignment) are not. Do NOT use this to look up a card's market value or recent sales (this tool does not price cards), and do NOT use it for non-trading-card categories. Present competitor and eBay figures as estimates, never as guaranteed proceeds, and never claim one platform is universally cheapest.

acquisition_cost.description: Optional. What the seller paid for the card; used to estimate net profit per method.

currency.description: ISO currency code. Only USD is supported.

ebay_fee_percent_override.description: Optional. Override the estimated eBay final value fee percentage (e.g. for a seller with an eBay Store subscription).

ebay_store_subscription.description: If true, estimate eBay fees using the eBay Basic-or-higher Store subscriber rate (12.35% up to $2,500/item) instead of the individual rate (13.25% up to $7,500/item).

item_category.description: Item category. Only trading_cards is supported.

methods.description: Which selling methods to compare. Defaults to eBay, Pulltrader marketplace, and Pulltrader storefront. Other supported methods (off by default): pulltrader_fbp, pulltrader_pos, and estimated competitor marketplaces tcgplayer, manapool, misprint, fanatics_collect, goldin.

quantity.description: Number of identical items in one order. Per-order fixed fees are applied once.

sale_price.description: The per-item sale price (the card's listed/sold price), in the given currency.

seller_covers_fees.description: If true, the seller absorbs the Pulltrader platform fee (3.25% + $0.40). If false (default), the buyer pays it at checkout. The platform fee is always charged on Pulltrader card sales regardless.

seller_level.description: The seller's actual level (1-5), if known. Level is set from plan AND sales volume, so levels 2 and 4 exist only by earning them and cannot be inferred from a plan. Overrides the plan's rate: 1=91%, 2=92%, 3=93%, 4=94%, 5=95%.

seller_plan.description: Pulltrader seller plan. Sets the payout floor (free/operations=91%, business/managed=95%); a seller level earned on revenue can be higher.

shipping_amount.description: Shipping amount charged to the buyer. Affects eBay's fee base. See assumptions for how each method treats shipping.

name: compare_selling_costs
title: Compare trading-card seller proceeds across selling methods
